Create ONE coherent native-style 16-bit PIXEL ART BOSS ANIMATION SHEET for Midlife Survivors: THE HOLIDAY PARTY, a fictional relentlessly cheerful office coworker leading a conga line. Attached boss sheets are EXACT PIXEL STYLE AND GRID references, not costume references. Match chunky readable square clusters, one-native-pixel navy silhouette, three stepped hue-shifted tones per material, upper-left light, neutral white balance, elevated three-quarter top-down camera, big friendly head, warm comic tone. No realistic painting, blur, antialiasing, gradient, sepia or golden haze.

GRID: 4 columns x3 rows =12 equal cells. Native576x456,144x152 each; preferredsource1728x1368 (3x). No padding BETWEEN cells, no drawn grid, no labels. Every active figure fits inside own cell with4nativepixel clear margin. Sharedfootanchor72,148, fullbody, identicalheadsize/outfit/camera/scale acrossposes. EXACTFLATOPAQUEMAGENTA #FF00FF everywhere outsideart. NO floor, NOcastshadow, NOglow. LastcellBOTTOMRIGHT entirelyblankmagenta. EXACTLY11activeposes.

CHARACTER: Short round/bouncy fictional coworker, friendly mature face, rosy cheeks, HUGE grin, curly RUSSET hair. Lopsided pointed TEAL PAPER PARTY HAT with cream STRIPES, not a Santa hat. Chunky UGLY HOLIDAY SWEATER in SAGE and RUSSET, simplecream snowflakes and small GENERIC KNITTED REINDEER icon, no text/logos. Coffeeorange tinsel scarf. Tan khaki pants. Pink-and-cream novelty socks, simple russet/dark loafers. One hand holds a cup of red punch. A thin stick attached to partyhat dangles ONE mistletoe sprig (sage/tealgreen leaves, warmwhite berries), clearly attached aboveface. Hat+stick+mistletoe within eachcell. No second person. Joyful and relentless, silly affection, not threatening.
